subcommands.disable: Disable one or more unit files
subcommands.enable: Enable one or more unit files
subcommands.is-enabled: Check whether unit files are enabled
subcommands.is-failed: Check whether units are in a failed state
subcommands.kill: Send a signal to processes of a unit
subcommands.restart: Start or restart one or more units
subcommands.show: Show properties of units, jobs, or the manager
subcommands.status: Show runtime status of one or more units
